Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379),
I return the Agreement signed with many thanks. I shall be quite satisfied with the arrangement about [the £1000 for the copyright](../others.html#160) being paid half next March and half the March after.

One book you do not mention, the [Christian names](../books.html#48), I should be very glad if the end of that could be so got rid of, that I could cut it down correct it, add some recent discoveries and something about surnames, and make a small saleable book of it.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
